rules.name: Guiding Mirrored Scales
rules.description: Each Melee Attack allocated against the model that rolls a ‘1’ to hit, is instead allocated to the attacking model’s Health Pool with Automatic Hits.

rules.name: Guiding Digestive Vomit
rules.description:
If a model with Digestive Vomit is on on the winning side of a Combat, it gains +1 Str and +1 AP.

 Duration: Permanent.

rules.name: Guiding Segmented Shell
rules.description: Attacks with Multiple Wounds(X) against the model reduce their X by 1, to a minimum of 1.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Each time a model with Acid Blood loses a Health Point after failing a Regeneration Save against an enemy Melee Attack, it immediately inflicts 1 hit with Toxic Attacks towards the Health Pool of the attacking model, before any casualties are removed.

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text:
Magical Attacks, If the model did not move during this Player Turn, the number of shots is Maximised
Before rolling for the number of Shots, the owner may choose to discard 1--3 Veil Tokens from their Veil Token pool. If so, the number of Shots is increased by +3 per discarded Veil Token.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: If the model is in contact with an enemy unit containing a Magic Item during Step 2.b of each Round of Combat (Calculate Static Combat Score), add +1 to Combat Score.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: Enemy units in contact with the model lose Devastating Charge.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The model part’s Melee Attacks gain +1 Str and +1 AP.
For each Melee Attack where a ‘1’ is rolled to wound, the model with Curved Tusks suffers a hit that wounds automatically, with AP 10.

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text:
Magical Attacks, Armour Save Modifier
Armour Save rolls of ‘1’, ‘2’, ‘3’, and ‘4’ are always considered failed when saving wounds caused by Dark Fire.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: Start of Vanguard Units (Battle Setup, 3.F), you may remove any unit entirely with this Manifestation from the Battlefield and Deploy them again elsewhere, following the general Deployment restrictions.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
For each Health Point loss the model causes with Melee Attacks, roll a D6 at the end of the Agility Step.
For each 4+ rolled, the model gains +1 Health Point.
If the model’s Health Points reach 20 or more, all units within 9" immediately suffer 2D6 hits with Toxic Attacks, and the model is removed as a casualty.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The first time the model with Digestive Vomit is on the winning side of a Combat, it gains +1 Str and +1 AP, with Duration: Permanent.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
During Combat Choices the opponent must choose a Character from one of their units that is in contact with the model's unit. The chosen Character and the model with Divine Right counts as being in contact with each other.
In addition, while the model with Divine Right is in contact with an enemy Character, do not roll for determining its stats, instead all random characteristic are considered to have rolled the maximum possible value.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Extraordinary.
The model’s base size is changed to 150×100 mm, its Height is changed to 5, its Health Points are set to 9, its Charge Speed is set to 5.
In addition, it loses Attached, Exclusive, and War Platform, and it gains Solitary, Stomp Attack (D6), and Terror.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
At the start of Determine Agility Order (Melee Phase, 3.A), the model’s Agility is set to twice the model’s current number of Health Points.
At the start of each Agility Step, the model’s Defensive Skill and Offensive Skill are set to twice the model’s current number of Health Points.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: Courage Tests taken by the unit gain Minimised.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Daemonic Manifestations that have options for Guiding Manifestations have two point costs: the “Guided version”’s point cost and rules are written with this colour-coding and notation.
Guiding versions must be noted on your Army List.
Guiding Manifestations affect both the bearer and all Rank-and-File models in the bearer’s unit, as if the models themselves had the Daemonic Manifestation.
Note that Guiding and non-Guiding Manifestations are considered to be the same Daemonic Manifestation.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
One use only.
May be activated just before the model’s unit rolls a Break Test: that Break Test is automatically failed, and the HP loss suffered from Supernal is halved, rounding fractions down. Duration: One Phase.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The model part gains Breath Attack (Str 3, AP 2, Magical Attacks, Stand and Shoot).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: Melee Attacks allocated by the model against an enemy unit’s Flank or Rear Facing gain +1 Str and +1 AP.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Changes to the model’s profile:
  • Base size changed to 100×100mm.
  • HP set to 6.
  • Number of Tillers and Hellsteeds set to (3).
  • Tillers lose Smother (1) and gain Smother (2).
  • Chassis gains Impact Hits (3D3).
  • Single model.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: One use only. May be activated at the start of a friendly Charge Phase: when activated, the model gains Horror, and its Charge Range rolls are Maximised. Duration: One Phase.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Casting Rolls for Learned Spells made by a model with Daemon in this army using two or three Magic Dice gain a +1 modifier.
In games involving one or more Daemon Legions armies, the Active Player gains one additional Magic Dice during their Magic Phase’s Siphon the Veil step (i.e. both players gain one additional Magic Dice in their Player Turn).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
Aegis (3+, against Flaming Attacks) and Flaming Attacks (Melee & Shooting).
The model automatically fails all Regeneration Saves.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: At the beginning of the Agility Step when the model’s Standard Melee Attacks are allocated, select one model part from each enemy model in contact with this model. Add their Attack Value Characteristics, excluding any modifiers, to the Attack Value of the Kuulima's Deceiver. Duration: Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: During Pre-game Selections, each Exalted Herald model part must choose two different Manifestations from the list below, and select two spells out of those indicated in the selected Manifestations, Wrath of God (Thaumaturgy), and Hellfire (Hereditary Spell) (this replaces the normal rules for Spell Selection connected to being a Wizard Adept).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The unit or model knows (or gains) Spear of Infinity (Hereditary Spell) as an additional Learned Spell.
If the unit or model is not a Wizard, it instead gains Wizard Conclave (1), and knows Spear of Infinity (Hereditary Spell).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: Each Melee Attack allocated against the model that rolls a ‘1’ to hit is instead allocated to the attacking model’s Health Pool, with Automatic Hits.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
During Pre-game Selections, each unit of Veil Serpents must choose one of the following Manifestations — it gains the chosen Manifestations, with Duration: Permanent:

• Mesmerising Plumage
• Torporous Tendrils
• Venom Sacs

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model’s Charge Range rolls towards units containing Height 5 gain Maximised.
Impact Hits gain Multiple Wounds (D3, towards Height 5).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: If one or more models with Omniscience have neither Marched nor Charged in this Player Turn, the owner’s limit on Excess Magic is increased by 2.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model part can allocate its Stomp Attack onto Health Pools of Height 4 or less (rather than 0-1).
If the model part’s Stomp Attack is allocated towards a Health Pool with Height (3–4), the total number of its hits is halved, rounding fractions up.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Zeal while Engaged in the Flank or Rear Facing of an enemy unit.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: Attacks with Multiple Wounds (X) against the model reduce their X by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: Melee Attacks towards a model with Height X gain +1 to hit and +1 to wound.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: During the Siphon the Veil step of your Magic Phase, gain one Magic Dice for each unit containing this Manifestation.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The target suffers one hit with Str 2, AP 2, Area Attack (1×5), Direct Hit (Str 4, AP 3, Multiple Wounds (2)), and Magical Attacks.
The hits from Spear of Infinity gain +1 Str for each spell successfully cast before this spell during the current Magic Phase (including other instances of Spear of Infinity).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model’s Height is changed to 5.
In addition, its HP are set to 7, its Charge Speed and Mobility are both set to 7", and it gains Fly, Light Troops, Solitary, Stomp Attack (D6), and Terror.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Whenever the model loses a Health Point, it gains +1 Agi.
Whenever it Recovers or Raises a Health Point, it suffers -1 Agi

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model part gains Grind Attack (X).
After each Round of Combat, X increases by 1 (e.g. Grind Attack (1) becomes Grind Attack (2))
When the model is not Engaged in Combat, X is set to 1.
When a model part with Tightening Grasp is in the second rank, and not in contact with any enemy model, it can make all its hits from Grind Attack across models directly in front of it in the Front Rank.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: Model parts without Mount or Construct gain Grind Attack (D3, Str 5, AP 2, Magical Attacks, Unmodifiable).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: When an enemy Character is removed as a casualty as a result of Melee Attacks from a model part on this model without Construct or Mount, add +3 to the model's side's Combat Score during this Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: After a Round of Combat in which at least one attack with Unholy Appetite has caused a HP loss, all attacks with Unholy Appetite gain Hatred until the end of the next Player Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: For every successfully cast spell in the opponent’s previous Magic Phase, this unit’s Ambush rolls gain one instance of Maximised.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model’s Charge Speed and Mobility are both set to 7", and it gains Fly.
